note: Anyone may add a recipe to Cookwala (RFC-0013, docs/CONTRIBUTE-RECIPES.md). Each contributor claims one id prefix here, once, in the same pull request as their first recipe. Every recipe under recipes/community/<prefix>/ must use that prefix. tools/check_community_namespaces.py enforces this in CI; it also runs inside tools/validate_specs.py.
rules: A prefix is 2-16 lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, must not collide with a reserved prefix below or with any prefix already claimed here, and every recipe id under it must start with '<prefix>-'.

Proof of ownership is whichever GitHub login opened the claiming pull request; 'owner' here must equal that login. Moving a namespace to a different login needs a pull request from the current owner (or a maintainer, if the owner is unreachable, recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md).
A namespace is never deleted once merged, even if every recipe under it is later recalled: the claim stays as a tombstone so the prefix can't be impersonated.
This file lists community-submitted recipes only. The founder's own collections (archive, chefteta, osool, abdennour, abuhaty, world) are reserved below and are not claimable.

namespaces.description: Reference example used in docs/CONTRIBUTE-RECIPES.md and the conformance vector for this file. Not a real recipe collection.

Intake bucket for recipes submitted through the 'Submit a recipe' issue form (no git required). tools/recipe_from_issue.py writes new submissions here; a maintainer renames the file and id into the contributor's own namespace (claiming one on their behalf if needed) before or when merging.
